notes.title: No Such Luck - Walkthrough+Mod!
notes.notes:
[p]Today is finally the release of the WT+WT Mod for No Such Luck![/p][p][/p][p]The DLC/WT Will continue to be updated as the game is updated - as new content is made for the game, [/p][p]the WT will be updated to match.[/p][p][/p][p]For now the DLC contains a Mod for NSL, and a companion WT PDF.[/p][p][/p][p]The Mod might be a little different than you're used to. Here's a few screenshots explaining it. Explanations can also be found in the in-game help tab.[/p][p][/p][p]In the Options Menu, you'll see a new tab with the DLC installed:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111347/182744a1258f6e028237bbb74b8bacd6b1bd91f1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Full Mode adds commentary along with choices including what effects they have. It also provides commentary/explanations prior to every freeroam. Full Mode also includes the Paths Guide explained below.[/p][p][/p][p]Basic Mode only contains the Paths Guide. Because of how branching is handled, to enable most WT functionality, you must select a path from the Paths Guide. Each one comes with a brief description of the path - shown as such here.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111347/4f0a8bb7aaa95e88b350c27bb404a974811e9755.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Once you've selected a path the game will color-code all choices that affect that path. Choices which have no effect will not be highlighted in any way. If Full Mode is enabled, commentary will still be on.[/p][p][/p][p]The Paths Guide is accessible from a tab at the top right of the screen in the very beginning - although it disappears fairly quickly. From that point on, it can be accessed from your phone (During Freeroams in CH1 and 2, and at all times in CH3). From your phone you can also directly open the companion PDF via the "WT" Icon shown here:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111347/757ef2d9e377d6ef40e38c0d13a893e1ea347baf.png"][/img][/p][p]Finally, the PDF can also be opened directly from the Main Menu. [/p][p][/p][p]That's all - if you encounter any issues or bugs feel free to report them in the Community Hub for the main game. Enjoy the WT DLC for No Such Luck![/p]

notes.title: Chapter 5 Release!
notes.notes: [p]Patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Added Chapter 5 - the first chapter of episode 2![/p][/*][*][p]Tons of minor bugfixes/typos.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Previously" on to the beginning of Chapter 5. This can be skipped via a button up top. It may be slightly buggy as it was a literal last minute addition, but I did do as much testing as I could manage, so hopefully not![/p][/*][*][p]New minigame - only available on certain paths - disabled if minigames are turned off.[/p][/*][*][p]Updates to Statistics App. Fanlyhub didn't get an update this release, but it's possibly it may get one in a later patch.[/p][/*][*][p]4k+ New renders, 30+ Animations, 60+ New Music tracks, and tons of new story content![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Announcing the release of Chapter 5![/p][p][/p][p]As always, check the community hub or discord to report any bugs. Walkthrough is currently awaiting approval, and will hopefully be available soon - more info on that when the DLC is available - ETA unknown, but ASAP![/p]

notes.title: Ch5 Info
notes.notes: [p]Chapter 5 is on it's way! The final touches to the initial build of CH5 are being completed now[/p][p]and playtesting is ongoing.[/p][p][/p][p]Currently CH5 release on Steam is slated for Aug 12th. Either with CH5, or soon after a[/p][p]small DLC package will also come out - containing a full PDF walkthrough, as well as an [/p][p]in-game walkthrough mod - note, this may be delayed as much as a week after the initial CH5 [/p][p]release, but it is coming![/p][p][/p][p]A full breakdown+patch notes will be available when CH5 is released. For now a quick rundown -[/p][p]CH5 is the first chapter of Episode 2 - containing over 4k renders, 30+ animations, 60+ new Audio [/p][p]tracks, as well as a few small bugfixes to earlier content. [/p][p][/p][p]So Stay tuned for CH5 - coming to Steam August 12th![/p]
